# Among The Letters

> A literary newsletter for writers and readers. Among The Letters gathers verified Monday writing opportunities, daily literary discoveries, and a Sunday evening Weekly Discoveries Roundup for paid subscribers.

Among The Letters is an independent Substack publication (est. 2026). The free portions of regular Morning and Afternoon editions are meant to be useful on their own. Paid subscriptions expand those editions and include the Sunday roundup. The public website archive shares Afternoon Discoveries PDFs only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://amongtheletters.com/): Overview of the publication, editions, genre week, subscriptions, and editorial approach
- [Archive](https://amongtheletters.com/archive/): Public PDF archive of Afternoon Discoveries editions
- [Full site description for LLMs](https://amongtheletters.com/llms-full.txt): Thorough plain-language summary of Among The Letters for AI systems
- [Substack](https://amongtheletters.substack.com/): Subscribe free or paid; manage billing through Substack
- [Contact](mailto:amongtheletters@gmail.com): Email amongtheletters@gmail.com for founding lifetime membership and other inquiries
